name: The Beetmachine Collection (all 3)
description: The drums: a kick, a snare and the hats and cymbals, every hit synthesised and no samples anywhere. Three drum synthesisers for Windows, with their manuals and their standalones. Each plug-in in here is byte-for-byte the same file as its own download.
note: Windows VST3 · 19 MB · three drum synthesisers · all manuals included.
